description: A web API is a set of tools the browser offers to JavaScript. Some tools work with text, files or page size. Others ask for permission. Learn a small useful job for each tool and handle cases where it cannot work. Use these examples in a local page in a current browser. APIs involving files, storage, clipboard or location may need HTTPS, a user action or permission. They are shown as code because this site's sandbox limits those features.
versionNote: Uses standard browser APIs with feature checks and local sample data.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to write a local books.json with a two-item array
Learn to store a second title and check the length
Learn to change the rectangle width and colour
